name: Buried Force Gem
description: A buried Force Gem that can be revealed by digging or activated by a room variable.

fields.name: Activation Variable
fields.description: The local variable number that triggers or activates this actor. (0 = always active)

fields.name: Buried State
fields.description: Defines the buried state and activation behavior of the Force Gem.

0.name: Buried Visible
0.description: The Force Gem is buried but visible.

1.name: Buried Deep
1.description: The Force Gem is buried deeply and is not initially visible.

2.name: Buried Visible, Requires Active Variable
2.description: The Force Gem is buried but visible and requires a room variable to be active.

3.name: Buried Deep, Requires Active Variable
3.description: The Force Gem is buried deeply and requires a room variable to be active.

5.name: Secret SE, Requires Active Variable
5.description: Triggers the secret sound effect when the required room variable is active.

fields.name: Spawn Type
fields.description: Defines the type of Force Gem spawned when dug up.

fields.name: Force Gem Type
fields.description: Defines the type of Force Gem to spawn.
